name: Ryan Simon
body:
Paul and I first met during our Little League years in Edgewood, and then reconnected again in Providence some 15 years later. I don’t have one particular memory of Paul but rather a series of vignettes—small, vivid moments of seeing him around town throughout my years in Providence.
Serendipitous cafe sessions on Broadway, randomly crossing paths in downtown on our bikes. And often finding him at one of the local spots, with one headphone over his ear behind the DJ booth. 

Every encounter with Paul was a moment of joy and presence. We’d catch up on life, talk about what was happening around town, and always begin and end with a hug. His presence was calming, full of love, and always marked by a genuine curiosity about my life and the world around him. Paul's spirit lives on in our memories, in the city we shared, and somewhere quietly with peace inside our souls.
